Works across 8 AI coding agents, with the same 17-skill set on each.
👻 Kiro-inspired. Similar spec-driven, agentic SDLC style as Kiro IDE.
cc-sdd v3.0 is a rework around Agent Skills and long-running autonomous implementation.
Review and validation look for boundary violations, not just style issues.
/kiro-spec-batch for multi-spec initiatives. Turn a roadmap into multiple specs in parallel, with cross-spec review to catch contradictions, duplicated responsibilities, and interface mismatches.
Claude Code and Codex are stable; Cursor, Copilot, Windsurf, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, and Antigravity are in beta.
No external dependencies; subagents are spawned through each platform's native primitive.
